source_review.notes: Checked all six references for identity, authority, publication or current status, and bounded claim scope. The two Google SRE book chapters support SLO terminology, target selection, business trade-offs, risk, and control-loop use. The SRE Workbook supports adoption conditions, rolling versus calendar windows, attainable and aspirational targets, iteration, and case-study scope. The current OpenSLO repository supports v1 indicator, objective, budgeting-method, and time-window fields and labels v2 work in progress. Google's current product-focused resource supports user-journey framing. All six canonical URLs returned HTTP 200 on 2026-09-06.
